# Hand Coded

> Hand Coded is a Barcelona studio that designs and builds interactive art installations, immersive spaces and real-time software: light, sound, AI and our own tools.

## Founders
- Cyril Laurier: Co-founder. PhD in music AI, Sony CSL researcher.
- Maya Benaïnous: Co-founder. Artist and engineer, creator of Ledotron.

## Work
- [Peupler / Populate](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=peupler): Mouawad + Laurier · 2022 – 2025 · Venice Biennale, Dakar Biennale, Boulogne. How can every living being, human and non-human, share the same territories? Peupler lets us see and feel the point of view of a tree watching our cities, a witness of the ecological changes it hopes for. A new kind of immersive room, made entirely of real-time generative content: nothing is a…
- [Retour aux Sources](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=retour-aux-sources): Mouawad + Laurier · 2019 · Maison Ruinart, Reims, UNESCO World Heritage. A root planted in a chalk cellar dug more than two thousand years ago, thirty metres underground. In that mineral darkness, it listens to the living world breathing at the surface. In real time, the root captures the climate data that makes champagne, temperature, humidity, rainfall and wind, and…
- [Rising](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=rising): Mouawad + Laurier · 2022 – 2025 · Nuit Blanche Paris, Llum BCN, MIRA, La Rochelle, Aveiro. An outdoor light and sound installation about our vulnerability. It turns the scientific data of sea level rise into a sensory experience: waves of light rise and flood the space in real time, like sunlight reflected on the sea. The piece is linked live to oceanographic data from the University of…
- [Hors du temps](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=ephemere): Mouawad + Laurier, with Art Explora · 2023 · Centre Robert Doisneau Paris, Sant Joan de Déu Barcelona, Lille University Hospital. The present moment as a living artwork. Simply by being there, visitors create a moving picture and an evolving music. No instructions, no prerequisites: anyone can play, whatever their motor or communication abilities. A depth sensor follows every movement in the room. We designed the generative…
- [Tientos al tiempo](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=tientos): Pablo Valbuena & Patricia Guerrero · coding and sound · 2020 – 2021 · CENTQUATRE-PARIS, Lux Valence. A flamenco show where light becomes a stage object. Rhythm is watched and form is heard: the light answers the singing and the dancer’s feet, and extends flamenco in time and space. We built the real-time sound analysis and the stage system that make the light respond to dance and song: onset and…
- [Maestro](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=maestro): Hand Coded & Tigre Lab · three interactive experiences · 2017 · Sharjah Light Festival, United Arab Emirates. Three interactive experiences projected onto a 500-metre-wide monument. Visitors touch a scale model of the building, and their gestures play sound and image across the whole façade. SAND: move grains of sand and compose a desert soundscape. ORGAN: become the DJ of an interactive looper that fires…
- [Future Ruins](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=future-ruins): Romain Tardy · software and engineering · 2015 – 2018 · La Nuit des Images, Lausanne, then Signal Festival Prague. A music and light performance on twelve handmade light structures, laid on the ground like the debris of an imaginary world, in front of a monumental projection. The challenge: keeping LED animation, video mapping and music perfectly in sync. We supported Romain Tardy from the technical choice of…
- [S.A.T.](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=sat): Romain Tardy · software and engineering · 2017 · SkyDesert Festival, Hebei, China. A large light, sound and image installation made of 72 networked modules, an attempt to send a message into space. By day they are mirrors reflecting the sky; by night they light up in patterns visible from far away. Visitors join a local wifi network with their phone. Their IP address appears on…

The first machine sensitive to music: a DJ stage made of moving LED structures, driven by an artificial intelligence that listens to the live mix and decides what to show, when and how. A semi-generative system that follows the artist’s design while keeping control of the image. We designed the…

It has run more than forty of them since 2015, from OX to Retour aux Sources. LED strips, moving lights, video walls and the venue itself are drawn in 3D; the show is composed on a timeline, and you see the result before a single cable is…

The albatross is almost impossible to observe: it spends 80% of its life between water and air and only lands to breed on the island where it was born. ## Expertise
- [Imagine](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=imaginer): Artistic and advertising concepts. We start from an intuition, a brand or a place, and invent the experience: what the audience will see, hear and set off. We write the concept, the device and the way it responds.
- [Explore](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=explorer): Consulting and workshops. You are looking for what is possible before knowing what you want. We bring your teams together, put the constraints on the table, test leads and help you pick the right one, even if it means steering the project elsewhere.
- [Build](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=fabriquer): Development and production. Real-time software, sensors, light, sound, electronics: we build the device from end to end, and run it on site or on tour.
- [Support](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=accompagner): Technical support for artists. An artist has the work in mind. We give them the tools to make it exist, from prototype to installation, without taking their place.
- [Machine learning & our own AI](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=machine-learning). Systems that listen, watch and decide: emotion detection in music, real-time choices on stage, recommendation engines.
- [Real-time development](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=real-time). Software that reacts within the frame: custom engines in C++, openFrameworks, OpenGL and shaders, built to run night after night.
- [Audio processing](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=audio). Sound analysis and generation that drive light, image and motion: beat detection, spatialisation, interactive music.
- [Generative animation](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=generative). Algorithms that generate designs and animations, for LEDs, screens and projection.
- [Projection mapping](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=projection-mapping). Projection on architecture, objects and bodies, synchronised with sound and sensors.
- [Light and LED control](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=light). From a few strips to thousands of LEDs and motors, designed and driven with Ledotron, over DMX and Art-Net.
- [Tracking and sensors](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=tracking). Kinect, Leap Motion, cameras, body and brain sensors: we turn people's presence and movement into data.
- [Concept design](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=concept-design). We join the brainstorm early, suggest the technologies that serve the idea, and carry it from concept to production.
- [Sustainable thinking](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=sustainable). Sustainable design approaches in the choice of materials, energy and durability of every installation.
- [Project management](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=project-management). One team from the first sketch to the last show, with artists, agencies and brands.
- [Our tools](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=tools). Autodesk Maya, After Effects, TouchDesigner, Photoshop, Xcode, MadMapper, Millumin, Ableton Live and our own Ledotron. C++, OpenGL, openFrameworks, Objective-C, SceneKit, Python, Max/MSP, GLSL, VST and WebGL.
- [Hardware and protocols](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=hardware). DMX, Art-Net, OSC, Kinect 1 and 2, Leap Motion, augmented reality, iOS, Android and Arduino.
- [Immersive](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=nouveau-contenu): Rooms of light, sound and data that answer the people inside them.. We design and build immersive spaces where image, light and sound are generated in real time, so the work is never the same twice. Cameras and sensors follow the visitors, live data from the climate, the music or the place feeds the content, and the room becomes a living environment rather than a…

## Studio
- [Cyril Laurier](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=cyril): Co-founder. PhD in music AI, Sony CSL researcher. · Barcelona. His PhD at the Music Technology Group of the Universitat Pompeu Fabra used machine learning to detect emotions in music. Before that, he studied acoustics, signal processing and computer science applied to music at IRCAM (ATIAM master), where he wrote a generative algorithm for automatic music…
- [Maya Benaïnous](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=maya): Co-founder. Artist and engineer, creator of Ledotron. · Barcelona. Artist and engineer, she creates immersive installations at the crossroads of ecology, technology and the senses, and has worked with real-time data since 2008. She invented a new way to work with LEDs: Ledotron. Trained in mathematics, biology and art and technology (IMAC engineering school), she…
- [Stéphanie Huerre](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=stephanie): Maths, art and new technologies, sustainable design. · Barcelona. Ten years at Walt Disney Imagineering R&D, where she led a 3D AI simulation tool to study crowd flow and visitor experience in theme parks, and brought sustainable design into the process. She likes riding her bike.
- [Romain Tardy](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=romain-tardy): Visual artist. OX, S.A.T., MGNTRN, Future Ruins, TGIC. Hand Coded designed and developed his creation and control tools from 2014 to 2021.
- [Pablo Valbuena](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=pablo-valbuena): Visual artist. Kinematope, Gyrotope, Wave, Methods, Tientos al tiempo. Hand Coded designed and developed his creation and control tools from 2014 to 2020.
- [Adrien M & Claire B](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=adrien-m-claire-b): Digital arts and performance company. Mouvement de l’air, world tour.
- [Beardyman](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=beardyman-musician): Musician
- [Maotik](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=maotik): Visual artist. EKO, with Ezra, MIRA Festival 2014.
- [Ezra](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=ezra): Beatboxer, Organic Orchestra. Bionic Orchestra and EKO, with the Organic Orchestra company, from 2008.
- [Marina Pujadas](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=pedra): Artist and costume designer
- [Jesse Watts](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=jesse-watts): Sound engineer. Pilote de drone, et preneur de son.
- [Paul Brossier](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=paul-brossier): PhD, music developer

- [Joan Sandoval](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=joan-sandoval): Creative coder · Barcelona. Creative coding and audio development on Maestro, Peupler, Éphémère and Paysage Sonore.
- [Ben Kuper](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=ben-kuper): Technical director, creative coder. Technical director and coder, inventor of Chataigne, the open-source software that links show control, sensors and media. Creative coding on Peupler.
